description: Start an async Director compose job: it authors an ensemble of full composition candidates, verifies each, and saves the winner to the project. Body must set EXACTLY ONE source (mutually exclusive): `briefId` — author FROM a persisted Brief (the PLANNED path: create_brief first; every Brief field is honored or the compose is refused loudly naming the field); `fromComposition: true` — author from the project's CURRENT composition (the GENERAL path: seed it with apply_composition first — your media clips are the intent, and any graphics you authored are CARRIED VERBATIM as locked clips the Director authors around, never re-authors or drops); or `suggestionId` — author from an AI clip suggestion (the CLIPPING path, paired with suggest_briefs). Returns { composeJobId, status, streamUrl }. Then call wait_job(kind="compose", id=composeJobId, projectId=...) to block until the winner is selected.

briefId.description: Compose from a persisted Brief (create_brief) — the intent-first door: every Brief field is HONORED or the request is refused loudly naming the field (window from beat moment-pinning; seeded graphics carried VERBATIM as locked clips; exclusions enforced; locale + caption emphasis threaded to the Director). Exactly ONE of suggestionId | fromComposition | briefId.

budgetUsd.description: Per-job budget cap (USD). Clamped at the route against the org's composeMaxBudgetUsdPerJob setting.

clientNonce.description: Opaque caller token that disambiguates intentional same-critique retries. Without it, identical (project, sug, seed, critique) tuples deduplicate; with it, retries create a fresh execution.

critique.description: Structured critique block (per compose-api-contract.md decision #11). Capped at 2KB total; per-criterion blocks capped at 500 chars.

format.description: Optional format override. Phase 2 ignores this — format precedence is project.compositionFormat → 9:16 fhd 30fps default.

fromComposition.description: Reuse the project's current composition as the compose starting point (critique-retry path). The Director RE-AUTHORS graphics: if the current composition is client-authored and contains graphic clips (overlay/component/card), the request is refused (validation_error naming the clips) — render it verbatim with create_render instead. The director's own output (critique-retry) is exempt.

holdAt.description: Opt-in checkpoint gates. Each named stage pauses the compose at its boundary (status → awaiting_input) for client review via resume. Absent/empty ⇒ fully autonomous. Non-empty ⇒ the run is a single spine.

maxCandidates.description: Ensemble size, 1–5. Defaults to one; explicit multi-candidate runs divide the job budget across candidates and admit at most two concurrently. A held editorial checkpoint always uses one candidate.

parentJobId.description: Pointer to the prior compose job this run iterates on. Surfaced on the resulting compose job as baselineComposeJobId.

qualityThreshold.description: Composite-score accept threshold. Server default per contract.

scope.description: RequestScope discriminated union (per compose-api-contract.md). Editor-only scopes (captions/overlay-track/broll/overlay-instance/segment) require an editor-session token; API tokens get 403 on those.

name: compose

composeJobId.description: Opaque compose job id; pass to the SSE stream URL.

status.description: queued = normal; failed = startup failed and the job is already terminal (the SSE stream will emit a single `job_failed` frame and close).

streamUrl.description: Relative SSE endpoint to stream this job's events (per compose-api-contract.md).
